content:
Daily scratchpad — account reminders / QBR prep / renewals / follow-ups
Date: 2026-04-18
Owner: Aisha Rahman

TOP PRIORITIES (today)
- Nimbus Health QBR (6/1 renewal) — finalize deck + ask list. Jordan prepping usage trends slides, Samira adding incident timeline.
- Acme Retail renewal (9/15) — confirm invoice owner + discount ask (pilot -> prod upsell).
- Follow up on Zendesk Z-12345 (kv-cache regressions) — assigned to infra-eng, need ETA.

ACCOUNTS / QUICK NOTES
1) Nimbus Health — HIGH TOUCH (ARR $240k) — renewal: 2026-06-01
   - Health: amber — recent latency regressions for long-form reports (p95 up 2x last month).
   - Open tickets: Z-12345 (kv-cache misses) — infra investigating, lead: Priya N.
   - QBR agenda draft: usage summary, incident timeline (Mar 24 outage), performance roadmap (quantization + batching plan), pricing/commit options.
   - Key contacts: Claire Nguyen (SRE), Mateo Alvarez (Engineering), procurement: Lindsay Park.
   - Ask list for QBR (what we need from them): updated expected QPS for next 12 months, approved headcount for integration, any compliance requirements for Private deployment.
   - Risk items: if infra ETA > 3 weeks, call out as renewal risk. Suggest 10% concession for 1-yr commit if they sign by 2026-05-15.
   - Action items:
     * Jordan: finish usage/latency slide + p95 charts (due 2026-04-20).
     * Samira: draft root-cause timeline for Mar 24 outage (due 2026-04-19).
     * Me (Aisha): schedule pre-QBR run with Claire (30m) week of 2026-05-11; draft renewal options and concession terms.

2) Acme Retail — MEDIUM TOUCH (ARR $95k) — renewal: 2026-09-15
   - Upsell opportunity: Dedicated capacity (they're currently hosted API) — estimated 20% unit cost savings for high-throughput inference.
   - Next steps: confirm architecture readiness for Dedicated; loop in solutions-engineering for sizing.
   - Linked artifact: JIRA CS-2123 (billing questions).

3) BetaDocs — LOW TOUCH (ARR $18k) — renewal: 2026-07-02
   - Support follow-ups: minor throttling complaints, recommended turning on autoscale burst for 2 weeks during campaign.
   - Action: send step-by-step autoscale guide + cost estimate (Aisha to send by 2026-04-20).

SUPPORT / TECH FOLLOW-UPS
- Z-12345 (Nimbus) — notes: kv-cache misses correlate with new tokenization change in model v2. infra-eng to test rollback. Need ETA before QBR.
- New ticket trend: increased embedding latency for >1k requests; product asked for batching/queue suggestion doc. Samira to draft quick guide (2 pager).

QBR DECK CHECKLIST (Nimbus)
- Slide: Exec summary (health + renewal ask) — DONE (draft)
- Slide: Usage + cost trends (Jordan) — IN PROGRESS
- Slide: Incidents & RCA (Samira) — IN PROGRESS
- Slide: Roadmap (short-term perf fixes + Dedicated options) — DRAFT
- Slide: Commercial options + timeline — DRAFT (include 1yr commit + discount options)
- Data to pull from console: 90-day token volume, p50/p95 latency by route, error rates by model, top 5 slowest prompts. (Jordan + me)

MEETING LOG / NOTES (quick jots)
- 2026-04-17 11:00 — quick sync with Claire (Nimbus). She reiterated top priority: stabilize p95 for reports; asked for canary window of 2 weeks. She is ok with commercial conversation after stability window.
- 2026-04-16 15:30 — internal: infra triage on kv-cache. Possible fix: disable new tokenizer patch for Nimbus only.

TO-DO (today / week)
- [ ] Send autoscale guide to BetaDocs (due 4/20)
- [ ] Compile p95 charts for Nimbus QBR (Jordan) (due 4/20)
- [ ] Draft incident RCA for Mar 24 outage (Samira) (due 4/19)
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated sizing meeting with Acme + solutions-eng (due 4/22)
- [ ] Follow up with infra on Z-12345 ETA (today)

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep concession math simple: show list price vs commit price vs effective discount. Prep two scenarios (12mo, 24mo).
- If Nimbus needs private deployment for compliance, route to Private PM and legal early — long lead time.
- Capture demo video for Dedicated capacity — ops can reuse in renewal call.

LINKS / REFERENCES

LAST QUICK CHECK

- Do we need legal for concession? probably not until they indicate verbal yes; flag legal once they ask for written concession.
